sources.snippet: CogniMed AI cognition applied to medicine. CogniMed is a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system for evidence-grounded biomedical question answering. It pairs a domain-tuned sentence-transformer for retrieval with a LoRA-fine-tuned BioGPT-Large language model for binary yes / no clinical reasoning, grounded in PubMed-derived passages.
